subject: Air freight quote to PVG
body:
Hi,

Could you quote the fastest air freight option to PVG (Shanghai, CN), including truck pickup from our warehouse to the airport?

The sports equipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-12-02: 11 pieces, 349 kg gross, 2.40 cbm.

Please send your all-in price in EUR.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio
